feed.title: Quantum Landmines and Vulnerable Coin Auctions

entry.title: Quantum Landmines and Vulnerable Coin Auctions
entry.summary:
If an individual is sufficiently prepared and attentive before the advent of quantum computing threats, transferring assets from a legacy Bitcoin address to a quantum-resistant wallet would be the most prudent step. The reasoning follows that anyone who recognizes the risks posed by quantum computers in advance and possesses both awareness and opportunity should prioritize safeguarding their funds rather than leaving them exposed.
There is little justification for knowingly maintaining vulnerable coins on legacy outputs unless the goal is to attract or trap future attackers. Such an approach, however, introduces unnecessary risks and incentivizes malicious activity, which is generally considered counterproductive within security best practices. The optimal course is proactive protection, ensuring that valuable assets are no longer susceptible to quantum attacks once these threats become practical concerns.
